// Generated byte-exact source cuts. Remaining caller suffixes are excluded.
use aspis_statement::pool_v1::POOL_V1_PAIR_VERIFIED_AFTERSTATE_BYTES;
use aspis_r1_cost_probe::{verifier,transport::Variant};
// Error identity is opaque here: only Ok/Err and successful slice identity are observed.
#[derive(Debug)]
enum ProgramError { InvalidAccountData }
type ProgramResult = Result<(),ProgramError>;
fn readonly_buffer_meta_ok(is_signer:bool,is_writable:bool,executable:bool)->ProgramResult {
    if is_signer || is_writable || executable {
        return Err(ProgramError::InvalidAccountData);
    }
    Ok(())
}
fn stage1_slice<'a>(proof_data:&'a[u8],candidate:&[u8])->Result<&'a[u8],ProgramError>{
    let proof_length = verifier::PROOF_BYTES;
    let proof_start = POOL_V1_PAIR_VERIFIED_AFTERSTATE_BYTES;
    let proof_end = proof_start.checked_add(proof_length)
        .ok_or(ProgramError::InvalidAccountData)?;
    if proof_data.len() != proof_end
        || proof_data[..proof_start] != candidate
        || proof_data[proof_start + 8] != Variant::S2.tag()
    {
        return Err(ProgramError::InvalidAccountData);
    }
    Ok(&proof_data[proof_start..proof_end])
}
struct ValidatedAsqa { proof_length:usize }
fn stage2_slice<'a>(proof_data:&'a[u8],validated:ValidatedAsqa)->Result<&'a[u8],ProgramError>{
    let proof_start = POOL_V1_PAIR_VERIFIED_AFTERSTATE_BYTES;
    let proof_end = proof_start.checked_add(validated.proof_length)
        .ok_or(ProgramError::InvalidAccountData)?;
    if proof_data.len() != proof_end {
        return Err(ProgramError::InvalidAccountData);
    }
    Ok(&proof_data[proof_start..proof_end])
}
